title: Home Care Evidence
user: A homeowner turning an inspection finding or completed repair into a repeatable maintenance record that another household member can understand years later.
current_workaround: Keep an inspection PDF, scattered photos, invoices, calendar reminders, and a vague to-do item in different locations.
smallest_useful_product: Local PWA with a maintenance card containing the observed issue, photos, vendor/DIY note, receipt attachment, due interval, and printable one-page history.
success_measure: In six months, pilot households can retrieve proof and the next due date for 90% of tracked home-care items in under one minute.
constraints: Attachments stay on device unless explicitly exported; encrypt exported archive option; no safety, building-code, or professional repair advice.
